title: File:Hotel Ruins in Varosha Ghost Town.JPG
author: Libresocietycy
description: Part of a hotel front in the Varosha Ghost Town, Famagusta CYPRUS. The tourist resort town was abandoned in 1974 after the Turkish Army captured most of Famagusta. This area was fenced off and never officially inhabited after the war, unlike the rest of Northern Cyprus. Painted on the exterior is a warning that "taking pictures or filming this is prohibited", written in Turkish.
